title: Mutmaßlich politisches Tatmotiv - Personengruppe greift zwei Männer an

extraction.summaryEn: Around 17:00 a group of about six masked people allegedly chased and attacked two men, aged 20 and 22, at a subway station after they passed a Middle East-related demonstration. One attacker allegedly used a knuckle duster; the State Protection unit is investigating a politically motivated assault.
